title: sfhotspot 1.1.0
text: hotspot_gistar() hotspot_classify() now use default Holm method p_adjust_method = NULL. P-values adjusted using spdep::p.adjustSP(); hotspot_classify() longer applies second adjustment across time periods. Use p_adjust_method = "none" retain unadjusted p-values (#94). New function hotspot_dbscan() identify clusters using DBSCAN algorithm, implemented dbscan package. Also added corresponding autoplot() autolayer() methods. New function hotspot_isoband() generalise values regular square hotspot grids tidy SF isobands appropriate visual representation (#81). Added autoplot() autolayer() methods hotspot_gistar() hotspot_dual_kde() results, completed plotting support hotspot_classify() results. Plot scales legends now reflect semantics result, including comparison method used dual KDE significance/sign filtering Gi* results. Legend titles consistently use lower-case terminology. new website plotting article demonstrates distinct behaviour (#85). hotspot_clip() can now clip type geometry, just point data (#65, #78) produces warnings clipping changes geometry type features way might create downstream problems. hotspot_clip() now preserves specialised hspt_* class results produced package functions (#71). hotspot_gistar() results now specialised class hspt_g, allowing downstream functions identify gistar primary value column (#82). Existing plotting methods now use transparent missing values, weighted counts present, sequential scales anchored zero, balanced diverging scales signed values (#85, #86). hotspot_clip() longer reports zero rows removed input features fall within clipping boundary (#66). hotspot_clip() longer suppresses warnings produced sf::st_intersection() constant “attribute variables assumed spatially constant throughout geometries” (since rarely relevant). hotspot_gistar() now calculates KDE values longitude/latitude data automatically transforming projected co-ordinate reference system transforming results back afterwards (#68). hotspot_dual_kde() now calculates valid KDE values longitude/latitude data using common automatically selected bandwidth layers, checks point layers overlap analysis grid (#67). hotspot_gistar() now uses weighted counts calculate Gi* statistics p-values weights supplied, autoplot()/autolayer() plot weighted counts present (#86). Automatic CRS transformation using st_transform_auto() KDE-related functions now correctly restores original geographic CRS rather converting EPSG:4326 even another geographic CRS originally used (#89). Automatic CRS transformation using st_transform_auto() hotspot_kde() hotspot_gistar() now ensures CRS selected data grid (#90).

Datasets can also automatically transformed /lat/lon using st_transform_auto() (#48). Functions now return useful error provided empty dataset (#58). Adjusted bandwidth now reported accurately (#56).
